# ui::SelectionItemProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The SelectionItem pattern: one selectable entry of a Selection container (a radio button, a list item). Implement [item_selected()](#item_selected) and [select_item()](#select_item); an entry of a container that selects several at once also overrides [add_to_selection()](#add_to_selection) and [remove_from_selection()](#remove_from_selection).

## item_selected

```cpp
virtual bool item_selected() const = 0
```

Whether this entry is selected.

## select_item

```cpp
virtual bool select_item() = 0
```

Make this the selected entry; true when it did.

## add_to_selection

```cpp
virtual bool add_to_selection()
```

Adds this entry to the selection and keeps the others; true when it did. The default is [select_item()](#select_item), for a container that selects one entry at a time.

## remove_from_selection

```cpp
virtual bool remove_from_selection()
```

Takes this entry out of the selection; true when it did. The default refuses, for an entry that is deselected only by selecting another one.

## ~SelectionItemProvider

```cpp
~SelectionItemProvider() = default
```
